Suitable for processing prompts in languages such as Hindi, Arabic, Marathi, etc. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: english_llm
function.description: This function provides interaction with an English large language model (LLM) to generate text-based answers. It operates exclusively on English language prompts and does not include real-time data or information post-2022. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

q.description: The English language prompt for the LLM to process and generate a response.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. One token roughly corresponds to one word.

temperature.description: The creativity level of the response, with a scale from 0.0 (deterministic) to 1.0 (creative). This is a float type value.

return_probabilities.description: Whether to return the probabilities of the generated tokens. If set to true, the response will include the likelihood of each token.

Here’s a whimsical little poem about kites:

**Kite‑Song**

In the sky’s wide canvas,  
A kite takes flight—  
Its tail a ribbon of colors,  
Swaying in delight.

It dances with the wind,  
A feathered friend,  
Carrying dreams on invisible strings,  
To the horizon’s bend.

When the sun paints gold across the clouds,  
The kite sings a silent song,  
A fluttering promise of freedom,  
Where hearts belong.

So let your worries drift away,  
Let your spirit take its cue,  
And watch your kite rise higher,  
In skies forever new.
